post.description: Send order details, allow multiple orders in one transaction.

put.description:
Send order details, allow multiple orders in one transaction.
NOTES:
  1. Send complete order info
  2. Return data is same as order creation
  3. Error will be returned, if update is not allowed

get.description:
Search by Order Number or ID, may request multiple
Return complete order info with current status.
Request Example:
https://api.toplogistics.com.au/wms/order?no[]=TEST001&no[]=TEST002
https://api.toplogistics.com.au/wms/order?id[]=562456&id[]=562457&full=false

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Return full order info or status and freight info only

delete.description: May request multiple Order Number or ID, similar to Search order.

post.description: Send product details, allow multiple products in one transaction.

put.description:
Send product details, allow multiple product in one transaction.
NOTES:
  1. Send complete order info
  2. Send complete product info
  3. Return data is same as product creation

get.description:
NOTES:
  1. Search by Order Number or ID, may request multiple
  2. Return complete order info with current status
Request Example:
https://api.toplogistics.com.au/wms/product?ean[]=562456&ean[]=562457
https://api.toplogistics.com.au/wms/product?sku[]=316456&sku[]=1342457

NOTES:
  1. May request multiple product in one query
  2. Stock data can be used to query historical stock info

put.description:
Used to transfer stock to a new entity.
NOTES:
  1. May request multiple stock in one query

post.description: Send return details, allow multiple returns in one transaction.

put.description:
Send return details, allow multiple returns in one transaction.
NOTES:
  1. Send complete return info

  3. Error while update is not allowed

basicAuth.name: Authorization
basicAuth.description:
Contains authentication data
Authorization: Basic QVBJX1VTRVI6YTlhZGI0MDE1YTJhZTBhZmQyMDI0ZDMzN2Q1NmE5ZDA=
Authentication data is generated in 4 steps,
  1. Form the string for hash check
    1. For POST and PUT with a request body, join JSON request body and API Key using |
      {"order_id": 2001234}|API_KEY
    2. For GET and DELETE without any request body
      1. Order request parameters in ascending order
      2. Convert the request parameters to JSON string
      3. Join the JSON string and API Key using |
      e.g. Request URL https://api.toplogistics.com.au/wms/order?no[]=TEST001&no[]=TEST002
      {"no":["TEST001","TEST002"]}|API_KEY
  2. Get MD5 hash of the joined string
    c99b3f19f33cc85323be07fa78302155
  3. Join API User name and MD5 hash using ":"
    API_USER:c99b3f19f33cc85323be07fa78302155
  4. Use base64 to get the authentication string
    QVBJX1VTRVI6YTlhZGI0MDE1YTJhZTBhZmQyMDI0ZDMzN2Q1NmE5ZDA=
